title: Chapter 1032
text:
Compared to when he was at level 300, the increase in his attributes was very obvious. However, this was mainly due to his level twenty-one energy bonus, which was what Han Xiao had accumulated during the version update.

As one's level increased, the increase in energy bonus would also increase. This was an important component of a Super's combat strength.

The Endurance bonus from the Promotion this time was + 90, which was 20 points more than the previous Promotion. It was getting more and more difficult to level up in the later stages of the Promotion, and the strength of each Promotion would increase accordingly. Furthermore, the sudden increase in Energy Rank also increased the Grade S Promotion bonus. There was a close connection between the various attributes, and the moment it was activated, Han Xiao's attributes were all strengthened.

A normal Promotion had given him such a huge increase, and Han Xiaoxin was very satisfied.

"As for these two thousand plus Free Attribute Points …"

Han Xiao thought about it and did not touch them for now. Now that his Intelligence and Endurance were both very high, he decided to increase them according to the situation.

As for the Potential Points, he continued to use them to level up his Class Knowledges, prioritizing the Ultimate Knowledges.

Currently, the Ultimate Knowledges that were maxed out were the three that he had obtained from the Level 300 Advancement Mission, [Eternal Energy Source], [Virtual Creator], and [Transdimensional Theory]. The other three were all knowledge that were not part of his class and had a threefold penalty. Leveling up from Level 1 to Level 5 required a total of 288 Potential Points.

Han Xiao had obtained quite a lot of Potential Points during the version update, so he upgraded these three Ultimate Knowledges a little. Now, the twenty-eight Potential Points on the interface were just enough to max out [Mechanical Life Tinder].

However, after thinking about it, he did not do so. Instead, he chose [Ultimate Mechanical Engineering] from the Armed Branch and leveled it up to level three.

This Class Knowledge was related to the crafting level. Han Xiao wanted to increase the success rate of crafting the King and the Emperor's Cape, so he had to level up this knowledge first.

"Plans can't keep up with changes. I originally wanted to wait in the bushes, but now I have to work while waiting." Han Xiao shook his head.

Now that he was alone outside, he could not use the workshop in the base, so he could only use the secondary dimensional weapon factory for now. Furthermore, he had to find a way to get the raw materials sent over.

Counting the days, he probably would not be able to create it before the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy appeared. The amount of work required to create a Universal Treasure was quite large, especially the enormous Emperor's Cape.

"Now that I'm Level 320, my combat power has increased significantly. The closer I get to the level of people like the Mecha Empire and the Void Overlord, the more I can feel their strength …" Han Xiao sighed.

Seeing the gap between their strengths getting closer and closer, he was quite happy.

However, after the advancement, the cost of leveling up skyrocketed again. In the later stages of the game, the effects of each advancement were extraordinary, and the cost of leveling up also increased by leaps and bounds.

"I'm afraid it'll take a long time to accumulate enough EXP to reach Level 340." Han Xiao nodded. "Also, I have to find an opportunity to ask about the God's Trait Transformation and the First Sanctum."

…

Constellation Corridor, Red Empire's mother planet, Tarunamir Palace, the empire's political center.

The important leader of the hardliners, Bekorodi, was resting in the conference room with his eyes closed. After a while, a remote projection appeared in the room. It was Gaud.

"You're here." Bekorodi opened his eyes.

"I hope you called me here to inform me of good news." Gaud's expression was calm.

"It is indeed good news," Bekorodi said with a deep voice. "The application you submitted has been approved. The dynasty's upper echelons have decided to let you use the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy … provided that your Esper Ability can really control the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy like you said."

The dynasty had placed a bet on Black Star, believing that he would be the most important national pillar in the future. However, the dynasty did not mind having a second person like him. After all, Gaud's Esper Ability was too rare. The dynasty was willing to spend a lot of effort to cultivate Gaud, who had extraordinary potential. Not to mention, this person was a direct member of the dynasty, not an ally who refused to listen to orders.

"I know how far my ability can go. As long as the dynasty is willing to trust me, I won't disappoint the dynasty." Gaud smiled calmly.

"As long as you can prove yourself, the dynasty won't be stingy with resources to cultivate you, just like Black Star now." Bekorodi's tone became heavier when he talked about Han Xiao.

Han Xiao's refusal to trade the Evolution Cube for three made Bekorodi very unhappy.

Hearing this, Gaud smiled faintly and did not say anything. He casually changed the topic and said, "The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy is about to appear.

"It's almost time for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to appear. How's the dynasty's preparation?"

Bekorodi nodded. "The dynasty has already sent troops to the locations indicated in the intelligence. At the same time, they've discovered the abnormal movements of many organizations. It can be confirmed that they have EsGod's legacy and are our competitors for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …"

"What kind of organizations are they?"

"Not many, but their composition is complicated. There are all kinds of organizations. However, Radiance and Ethereal don't seem to have made any moves. I'm not sure if they know …"

"Sounds like there are a lot of uncertainties. Can you guarantee that the dynasty will get the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy?"

"The current situation is still unclear. The dynasty's prophet has sensed some vague information and believes that the Emerald Star Cluster is the most likely place for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to appear. The Flickering World happens to be our territory, so the dynasty has decided to ask some Beyond Grade A allies for help," Bekorodi said.

"Black Star?"

"He's not a candidate for the dynasty." Bekorodi shook his head.

The Black Star Corps had the largest organization in the Flickering World. Logically speaking, asking Black Star for help should be the most reliable choice. However, the dynasty did not do so, and Bekorodi did not explain why.

Gaud's heart skipped a beat. He obtained some information from this sentence and smiled in his mind.

Tsk tsk, it seems like because of the Evolution Cube, the dynasty and Black Star are indeed on bad terms … It's probably like a fight between a couple?

Gaud's eyes sparkled, and he calmly said, "If that's the case, I have a suggestion. It's best to move Black Star away to avoid unnecessary trouble."

"I don't have the authority to order Black Star to do anything." Bekorodi waved his hands. "Recently, there was news saying that the Black Star Guards are all in Black Star Palace, and even Ames from the Shattered Star Ring went to visit. Therefore, Black Star's main body is most likely still in the base. It seems like he doesn't know anything and won't interfere …"

After pausing for a while, Bekorodi's expression darkened. "However, even if Black Star interferes, the dynasty can still make an exchange with him. With his current situation, the chances of him rejecting our proposal again are very small. He should know how to make up for his relationship with us."

"That's good. I don't want any accidents." Gaud narrowed his eyes.

The dynasty did not want to see a special talent like him face any risks before he grew up, so he was not allowed to interfere.

What Gaud had to do was to obediently stay at home and wait for the dynasty to hand over the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to him.

With the dynasty helping me, this is too convenient … Gaud laughed and shook his head.

—

Many things have happened in the past few days, so I don't have much time. I can only be a little shorter than usual. Everything will return to normal when I get home on the 18th.
